blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Former President Rodrigo Duterte may make his first in-person appearance before the International Criminal Court on Wednesday as the tribunal holds its third status conference on his case. The hearing will tackle key matters ahead of his trial, including the prosecution’s witnesses and evidence, disclosures to the defense, and the schedule for trial proper, which is set to begin on Nov. 30. /dp...
